pages.title: Quickstart
pages.description: Install the CLI, start a sandbox, let an agent build something inside it, and open it at a live URL.
pages.descriptionZh: 安装 CLI、启动沙箱、让智能体在其中构建应用，并通过实时 URL 打开它。

pages.title: Sandbox to deployment
pages.description: The full first walkthrough: create a sandbox, write code, preview it live, publish to production, and prove the deployment is running.
pages.descriptionZh: 完整的上手演练：创建沙箱、编写代码、实时预览、发布到生产环境，并验证部署正在运行。

pages.title: Agent-driven build
pages.description: Dispatch work to your agent, stream events, and collect artifacts from your backend, tagging every resource with your own customer IDs.
pages.descriptionZh: 将工作分派给你的智能体，流式传输事件，从你的后端收集产物，并用你自己的客户 ID 标记每个资源。

pages.title: Docker Host
pages.description: Run containerized applications on a workspace Docker Host host, then confirm the app is live.
pages.descriptionZh: 在工作区 Docker Host 上运行容器化应用，然后确认应用已上线。

pages.title: Install and authenticate
pages.description: Install the miosa CLI from npm, Homebrew, the install script or a release archive on macOS, Linux and Windows, verify 2.3, then sign in.
pages.descriptionZh: 从 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 上的 npm、Homebrew、安装脚本或发布存档安装 miosa CLI，验证 2.3，然后登录。

pages.title: Sandboxes or Computers?
pages.description: Pick where your app or agent runs on MIOSA: a Sandbox for code, previews and a built-in browser, a Computer for a full desktop, Docker Host to publish.
pages.descriptionZh: 选择应用或智能体在 MIOSA 上的运行位置：需要代码、预览和内置浏览器时用沙箱，需要完整桌面时用计算机，需要发布上线时用 Docker Host。

pages.title: Build and deploy a Next.js app
pages.description: Build a small Next.js app in a Sandbox, preview it, publish it as an immutable Deployment, prove it is live, connect a custom domain, and roll back safely - with the miosa CLI 2.x and the SDKs.
pages.titleZh: 构建并部署 Next.js 应用程序
pages.descriptionZh: 使用 miosa CLI 2.x 和 SDK 在沙盒中构建一个小型 Next.js 应用程序、预览它、将其发布为不可变的部署、证明它是实时的、连接自定义域并安全回滚。

pages.title: What you can build with MIOSA
pages.description: Concrete product patterns for MIOSA sandboxes, computers, agent runtimes, generated artifacts, previews, and deployments.
pages.titleZh: 使用 MIOSA 可以构建什么
pages.descriptionZh: 面向 MIOSA 沙箱、计算机、智能体运行时、生成产物、预览和部署的具体产品模式。

pages.title: Projects
pages.description: Group the resources for one app, site, or deliverable inside a Workspace, without becoming a runtime.
pages.descriptionZh: 在一个工作区内为一个应用、站点或交付物组织资源，同时不让项目本身成为运行时。

pages.title: Project lifecycle
pages.description: Create a project, add resources, configure environments and secrets, deploy, then retire it.
pages.descriptionZh: 创建项目、添加资源、配置环境与密钥、部署，然后下线。

pages.title: Project resources
pages.description: The project record, everything that attaches to a project, and how a project maps to your own platform.
pages.descriptionZh: 项目记录、附加到项目的一切，以及项目如何映射到你自己的平台。

pages.title: Members and usage
pages.description: Project members, permissions, usage attribution, the operating checklist, and common mistakes.
pages.descriptionZh: 项目成员、权限、用量归因、操作检查清单以及常见错误。

pages.title: Services
pages.description: Run web services, workers, private services and static sites in a project, with releases, variables, domains and rollback.
pages.descriptionZh: 在项目中运行 Web 服务、Worker、私有服务和静态站点，支持发布、变量、域名和回滚。

pages.title: Services quick start
pages.description: Take a repository to a live URL, add Postgres and Redis, add a worker, attach a domain, read a failed release and roll back.
pages.descriptionZh: 将仓库部署到可访问的 URL，添加 Postgres 和 Redis，添加 worker，绑定域名，读取失败的发布并回滚。

pages.title: Services and types
pages.description: The source, settings, address and limits of a web service, worker, private service, static site, cron job and database service.
pages.descriptionZh: Web 服务、Worker、私有服务、静态站点、Cron 任务和数据库服务的来源、设置、地址与限制。

pages.title: Static sites from Git
pages.description: Build a static site from a repository and serve it from the static lane, with an optional build command and output directory.
pages.titleZh: 从 Git 构建静态站点
pages.descriptionZh: 从仓库构建静态站点，并通过静态通道提供服务，可选用构建命令和输出目录。

pages.title: Service settings as code
pages.description: Put a service's settings in a file at the repository root, so the repository says how the service runs and the console shows where each value came from.
pages.titleZh: 以代码方式管理服务设置
pages.descriptionZh: 将服务的设置放在仓库根目录的文件中，让仓库说明服务如何运行，并在控制台中显示每个值的来源。

pages.title: Services variables
pages.description: Set a service's variables, reference another service's, share variables across an environment, and generate secrets.
pages.descriptionZh: 设置服务的变量、引用另一服务的变量、在同一环境中共享变量，并生成密钥。

pages.title: Services environments
pages.description: Every project starts with a production environment. Fork it into staging or a preview, and switch between environments on the canvas.
pages.descriptionZh: 每个项目都从生产环境开始。将其分叉为暂存环境或预览环境，并在画布上切换环境。

pages.title: Preview environments
pages.description: Open a pull request and MIOSA deploys it to its own environment with its own addresses, then removes it when the pull request closes.
pages.descriptionZh: 打开拉取请求，MIOSA 就会将其部署到拥有独立地址的专属环境中，并在拉取请求关闭后将其移除。

pages.title: Services releases
pages.description: Deploy a service, follow the release state machine, read a failure reason, promote or roll back, and cancel a release.
pages.descriptionZh: 部署服务、跟踪发布状态机、读取失败原因、提升或回滚，以及取消发布。

pages.title: Moving from Railway
pages.description: Bring a Railway project to MIOSA with one reviewed plan, every environment in its own Deploy target, services created stopped, and an exact list of what carries over and what you finish by hand.
pages.descriptionZh: 将Railway项目带到 MIOSA，其中包括一份经过审查的计划、每个环境都有自己的部署目标、已停止创建的服务以及一份保留的内容和您手动完成的内容的准确列表。

pages.title: Services replicas and scaling
pages.description: Set how many replicas a service runs, where, and how large they are, and what a scale change does to the running release.
pages.descriptionZh: 设置服务运行的副本数量、区域和规格，并了解扩缩容变更对运行中发布的影响。

pages.title: Dedicated vCPU
pages.description: Run a service on vCPUs that are one hardware thread each and never shared: sizes, prices, and how to select one.
pages.descriptionZh: 在每颗 vCPU 均为独立硬件线程且从不共享的配置上运行服务：规格、价格以及如何选择。

pages.title: Services logs
pages.description: Read a service's runtime logs per replica, the build log of a release, and the events that led to its state.
pages.descriptionZh: 按副本读取服务的运行时日志、某次发布的构建日志，以及导致其状态的事件。

pages.title: Service metrics
pages.description: Requests, errors and latency per service, and what the series does not measure.
pages.descriptionZh: 每个服务的请求、错误和延迟，以及这些序列不衡量哪些内容。

pages.title: Services CLI
pages.description: Every miosa service command and flag, from create and deploy to variables, domains, releases and rollback.
pages.descriptionZh: 所有 miosa service 命令和标志，涵盖创建、部署、变量、域名、发布和回滚。

pages.title: Services SDKs
pages.description: TypeScript and Python methods for services, releases, variables, addresses and projects.
pages.descriptionZh: 用于服务、发布、变量、地址和项目的 TypeScript 与 Python 方法。

pages.title: Docker Host
pages.description: Your own always-on host that runs apps published from a sandbox, with immutable versions, health checks and rollback. Formerly App Engine.
pages.descriptionZh: 您自己的永远在线主机，运行从沙箱发布的应用程序，具有不可变版本、运行状况检查和回滚。以前是应用程序引擎。

pages.title: Docker Hosts
pages.description: How a workspace Docker Host works: lifecycle states, publishing flow, proof, updates, recovery, runtime boundary, and domains.
pages.descriptionZh: 工作区 Docker Host 的工作原理：生命周期状态、发布流程、证明、更新、恢复、运行时边界和域。

pages.title: Docker Host templates
pages.description: Curated app shapes for Docker Host - Dockerfile, Compose, command, port, environment, and persistence defaults.
pages.descriptionZh: 为 Docker 主机精心设计的应用程序形状 - Dockerfile、Compose、命令、端口、环境和持久性默认值。

pages.title: Docker Host
pages.description: Run many small apps on one always-on workspace host while MIOSA owns routing, domains, and attribution.
pages.descriptionZh: 在一台始终在线的工作区主机上运行许多小型应用程序，而 MIOSA 拥有路由、域和归属。

pages.title: The deployment model
pages.description: How a publish becomes a stable production URL - the pipeline, static vs dynamic, deployments, versions, domains, and the proof contract.
pages.descriptionZh: 发布如何成为稳定的生产 URL - 管道、静态与动态、部署、版本、域和证明合约。

pages.title: Publishing
pages.description: Turn a Sandbox into an immutable Deployment Version. Source snapshots, build modes, static artifacts, dynamic runtimes, Docker Host containers, public URLs, and proof.
pages.descriptionZh: 将沙箱变成不可变的部署版本。源快照、构建模式、静态工件、动态运行时、Docker 主机容器、公共 URL 和证明。

pages.title: Deploy from GitHub
pages.description: Build and publish a GitHub repository with miosa deploy create --git - connect GitHub, public and private repositories, the branch, logs, redeploys, and the webhook that rebuilds on every push.
pages.descriptionZh: 使用 miosa deploy create --git 构建并发布 GitHub 存储库 - 连接 GitHub、公共和私有存储库、分支、日志、重新部署以及每次推送时重建的 Webhook。

pages.title: Versions
pages.description: Immutable history of every publish. Inspect, promote, archive.
pages.descriptionZh: 每次发布的历史记录都是不可变的。检查、宣传、归档。

pages.title: Releases
pages.description: The immutable build artifact: static files or dynamic server artifact, sha256-keyed.
pages.descriptionZh: 不可变的构建工件：静态文件或动态服务器工件，sha256 键控。

pages.title: Rollback
pages.description: Repoint a deployment at an older version. Seconds, no rebuild.
pages.descriptionZh: 将部署重新指向旧版本。秒了，没有重建。

pages.title: Environments
pages.description: Production, staging, preview/<source>: variable and secret scoping for deployments.
pages.descriptionZh: 生产、暂存、预览/<source>：部署的变量和秘密范围。

pages.title: Dynamic Runtimes
pages.description: Dynamic deployments: production runtimes started from a release, health-checked, and reconciled by MIOSA.
pages.descriptionZh: 动态部署：生产运行时从发布开始，由 MIOSA 进行运行状况检查和协调。

pages.title: Deployment Domains
pages.description: Preview domains, tenant deployment domains, managed fallback URLs, exact custom domains, DNS verification, automatic TLS, and route changes.
pages.descriptionZh: 预览域、租户部署域、托管回退 URL、精确自定义域、DNS 验证、自动 TLS 和路由更改。

pages.title: Forge
pages.description: Git hosting built into MIOSA: a home for code written by you, your sandboxes and your agents, with deploys, pull request previews and merge rules.
pages.descriptionZh: MIOSA 中内置的 Git 托管：由您、您的沙箱和您的智能体编写的代码的家，具有部署、拉取请求预览和合并规则。

pages.title: Forge quickstart
pages.description: Create a Forge repository, push to it with plain git and open your first pull request, in five minutes.
pages.descriptionZh: 创建一个 Forge 存储库，使用普通 git 推送到它并在五分钟内打开您的第一个拉取请求。

pages.title: Pull requests and checks
pages.description: Open a pull request on Forge, report checks, set branch policy and merge.
pages.descriptionZh: 在 Forge 上打开拉取请求、报告检查、设置分支策略并合并。

pages.title: Forge from a sandbox
pages.description: Clone and push to Forge from inside a sandbox with plain git, using the sandbox's own identity.
pages.descriptionZh: 使用沙箱自己的身份，使用普通 git 从沙箱内部克隆并推送到 Forge。

pages.title: Agents and the Forge API
pages.description: Use Forge from the TypeScript and Python SDKs and the REST API: repositories, files, branches, pull requests, checks and releases.
pages.descriptionZh: 使用 TypeScript 和 Python SDK 以及 REST API 中的 Forge：存储库、文件、分支、拉取请求、检查和发布。

pages.title: Forge CLI reference
pages.description: Every miosa forge command with an example: auth, repositories, pull requests, checks, branch policy, grants, forks and releases.
pages.descriptionZh: 每个 miosa forge 命令都有一个示例：身份验证、存储库、拉取请求、检查、分支策略、授权、分叉和发布。

pages.title: Forge limits and FAQ
pages.description: What Forge does and does not do yet: visibility, permissions, merge methods, issues, repository secrets and CI.
pages.titleZh: 伪造限制和常见问题解答
pages.descriptionZh: Forge 做了什么和没有做什么：可见性、权限、合并方法、问题、存储库机密和 CI。

pages.title: CI on MIOSA
pages.description: Run GitHub Actions jobs on MIOSA. Connect the MIOSA CI app, use runs-on miosa in a workflow, and each job runs in its own sandbox, billed per second.
pages.descriptionZh: 在 MIOSA 上运行 GitHub Actions 作业。连接 MIOSA CI 应用程序，在工作流程中使用运行式 miosa，每个作业都在自己的沙箱中运行，按秒计费。

pages.title: Sandboxes
pages.description: Fast, isolated Linux VMs for code execution, builds, tests, and dev servers, with live preview URLs and snapshots.
pages.descriptionZh: 用于代码执行、构建、测试和开发服务器的快速、隔离的 Linux VM，具有实时预览 URL 和快照。

pages.title: Capabilities
pages.description: What sandboxes are for, what a sandbox is concretely, and the core exec, files, preview, snapshot, and lifecycle capabilities.
pages.descriptionZh: 沙箱的用途、沙箱的具体用途以及核心执行、文件、预览、快照和生命周期功能。

pages.title: Create and connect
pages.description: Create a sandbox with the fused run endpoint or a full create, manage its lifetime in Python context managers, and connect to an existing sandbox by id or name.
pages.descriptionZh: 使用融合运行端点或完整创建创建沙箱，在 Python 上下文管理器中管理其生命周期，并通过 ID 或名称连接到现有沙箱。

pages.title: Docker in sandboxes
pages.description: Run containers inside MIOSA sandboxes, publish ports, and reach them through preview URLs. Which templates ship Docker Engine, Compose, and Buildx.
pages.descriptionZh: 在 MIOSA 沙箱内运行容器、发布端口并通过预览 URL 访问它们。哪些模板附带 Docker Engine、Compose 和 Buildx。

pages.title: Sandbox lifecycle
pages.description: The sandbox state machine from creating to destroyed, what each state means, what stop keeps, what resets the idle clock, and how to stop, pause, resume, and restart.
pages.descriptionZh: 沙箱状态机从创建到销毁，每个状态意味着什么，停止保留什么，重置空闲时钟什么，以及如何停止、暂停、恢复和重新启动。

pages.title: Files & Exec
pages.description: Read, write, watch files inside a sandbox. Run commands, stream stdout/stderr, manage processes.
pages.descriptionZh: 在沙箱内读取、写入、监视文件。运行命令、流式传输标准输出/标准错误、管理进程。

pages.title: Sizing and limits
pages.description: Named sandbox resource contracts, raw resource overrides, how sandbox usage is billed, and the opt-in runner fast path.
pages.descriptionZh: 命名沙箱资源合同、原始资源覆盖、沙箱使用如何计费以及选择加入运行程序快速路径。

pages.title: Timeouts and auto-stop
pages.description: The sandbox active-session timeout, how to extend it, and how runtime, CPU, and network usage are measured and reported.
pages.descriptionZh: 沙箱活动会话超时、如何延长它以及如何测量和报告运行时、CPU 和网络使用情况。

pages.title: Sandbox events
pages.description: Subscribe to sandbox lifecycle and activity events over SSE to monitor agent runs and detect unexpected exits.
pages.descriptionZh: 通过 SSE 订阅沙箱生命周期和活动事件，以监控智能体运行并检测意外退出。

pages.title: Connecting to a running sandbox
pages.description: Four ways into a live sandbox: the SDK, the CLI, SSH over an authenticated tunnel, and preview URLs. What each is good for, and what does not work.
pages.titleZh: 连接到正在运行的沙箱
pages.descriptionZh: 进入实时沙箱的四种方式：SDK、CLI、通过经过身份验证的隧道的 SSH 以及预览 URL。每种方法都有什么用，什么没用。

pages.title: Metadata and labels
pages.description: Attach arbitrary metadata to a sandbox at create time, read it back, and use external IDs for anything you need to query or bill on.
pages.descriptionZh: 在创建时将任意元数据附加到沙箱，读回它，并使用外部 ID 来查询或计费所需的任何内容。

pages.title: Long-running tasks
pages.description: Work that outlives a single exec: background processes, their logs and status, always-on sandboxes, and what comes back after pause and resume.
pages.descriptionZh: 比单个执行程序寿命更长的工作：后台进程、它们的日志和状态、始终在线的沙箱以及暂停和恢复后返回的内容。

pages.title: Production checklist
pages.description: The defaults to set on sandboxes before relying on them in production: timeouts, persistence, idempotency, templates, secrets, and event subscription.
pages.descriptionZh: 在生产中依赖沙箱之前，默认设置沙箱：超时、持久性、幂等性、模板、秘密和事件订阅。

pages.title: Machine capabilities
pages.description: What every machine ships with, its sizes, runtimes, and pre-installed tools.
pages.descriptionZh: 每台机器附带的内容、尺寸、运行时间和预装工具。

pages.title: Snapshots, restore, pause, and forks
pages.description: Create durable sandbox checkpoints, restore or fork new sandboxes, and preserve work through pause and resume.
pages.descriptionZh: 创建持久的沙箱检查点，恢复或分叉新沙箱，并通过暂停和恢复保留工作。

pages.title: Templates
pages.description: The one sandbox image, the templates that stage content inside it, the desktop, and how to start a Next.js, FastAPI, or static project.
pages.descriptionZh: 一个沙盒映像、在其中暂存内容的模板、桌面以及如何启动 Next.js、FastAPI 或静态项目。

pages.title: Sandbox shares
pages.description: Create a public, read-only link to a running sandbox so a teammate or an outside user can view it, and revoke the link at any time.
pages.descriptionZh: 创建指向正在运行的沙箱的公共只读链接，以便队友或外部用户可以查看它，并随时撤销该链接。

pages.title: Environment variables
pages.description: Set sandbox-level env at create time, inherit account-level runtime env by scope and target, and understand precedence, the per-sandbox env API, secret files, and secrets, and how a value reaches exec.
pages.descriptionZh: 在创建时设置沙箱级环境，按范围和目标继承帐户级运行时环境，并了解优先级、每个沙箱环境 API、秘密文件和秘密，以及值如何到达执行。

pages.title: Secrets  -  Quickstart
pages.description: Store API keys in MIOSA. Your sandbox uses an opaque placeholder. The real key never lives inside the VM.
pages.descriptionZh: 在 MIOSA 中存储 API 密钥。你的沙箱使用不透明占位符，真实密钥永远不会存在虚拟机内。

pages.title: Connect Accounts (OAuth)
pages.description: Authorize accounts (GitHub, Google, Slack, …) once. MIOSA manages token refresh; your sandbox sees an env var.
pages.descriptionZh: 一次性授权账户（GitHub、Google、Slack 等）。MIOSA 管理令牌刷新；你的沙盒只会看到一个环境变量。

pages.title: Managed connectors for sandbox agents
pages.description: Attach MIOSA-managed tools like Refero to sandbox or computer agents without client-supplied vendor tokens.
pages.titleZh: 沙盒智能体的托管连接器
pages.descriptionZh: 将 MIOSA 管理的工具（例如 Refero）附加到沙箱或计算机智能体，无需客户端提供的供应商令牌。

pages.title: SOMA
pages.description: SOMA is MIOSA's own open-source virtual machine monitor, written in Rust. It gives every sandbox a hardware-isolated machine with its own Linux kernel, restored from a certified snapshot.
pages.descriptionZh: SOMA 是 MIOSA 自研的开源虚拟机监视器，使用 Rust 编写。它为每个沙箱提供一台硬件隔离的机器，拥有独立 Linux 内核，并从经过认证的快照恢复。

pages.title: Choosing a runtime
pages.description: Choose Firecracker, SOMA or auto when you create a sandbox with the runtime option. List the runtimes your organization offers and see what each runtime reports it supports today.
pages.descriptionZh: 在使用 runtime 选项创建沙箱时选择 Firecracker、SOMA 或 auto。列出你的组织提供的运行时，并查看每个运行时当前声明支持的功能。

pages.title: Browser use
pages.description: A live browser inside any MIOSA sandbox - watch it, take control, share a view-only link, and let agents drive the same browser over CDP.
pages.descriptionZh: 任何 MIOSA 沙箱内的实时浏览器 - 监视、控制、共享仅供查看的链接，并让智能体通过 CDP 驱动同一浏览器。

pages.title: How browser use works
pages.description: The parts of a sandbox browser, the three surfaces that see it, and how the live view and CDP sockets are exposed.
pages.descriptionZh: 沙盒浏览器的组成部分、看到它的三个表面以及实时视图和 CDP 套接字的公开方式。

pages.title: Browser use quickstart
pages.description: Start a live browser in any MIOSA sandbox, read its stream and CDP endpoints, and stop it when you are done.
pages.descriptionZh: 在任何 MIOSA 沙箱中启动实时浏览器，读取其流和 CDP 端点，并在完成后停止它。

pages.title: Browser use live viewer
pages.description: Watch a sandbox browser live, take control, share a revocable view-only link, and go full screen.

pages.title: Page archetypes
pages.description: Every page on the site falls into a few structural classes: hub, tutorial, reference and interactive. Each has its own layout, template and checklist.
pages.descriptionZh: 全站页面按结构分成几类：导航型、教程型、参考型、交互型。每一类有自己的版面、模板与验收清单。

pages.title: Xici: A Formal Reconstruction
pages.description: Read the Xici as a rigorous treatise on generation, representation and control: the canonical twenty chapters, a chapter-by-chapter exegesis, a lexicon and a formal apparatus.
pages.descriptionZh: 把《系辞》当作一部关于生成、表征与控制的严密著作来读：五卷二十章的定本、逐章本注、术语映射与符号系统。

pages.title: The Canonical Treatise in Twenty Chapters
pages.description: The canonical text in five books: way and vessel, the conjugate operators, transition and continuity, formal representation, compression, and alignment.
pages.descriptionZh: 五卷二十章的定本全文：道器、乾坤、变通、法象、研几、趣时，去占卜、去音译，只留命题。

pages.title: The Lexicon: Fidelity, Grace, Reach
pages.description: Every core term with its canonical rendering, the rejected alternatives and the reasoning: no transliteration, no divination, no theology, only testable modern concepts.
pages.descriptionZh: 二十余个核心词的定本译法、淘汰译法与取舍理由：去音译、去占卜、去宗教，只留可检验的现代概念。

pages.title: Symbols and the Five Master Equations
pages.description: The five books and twenty chapters collapsed into an operator algebra: a symbol dictionary, the formal mapping, and a closed loop of five coupled equations.
pages.titleZh: 符号系统与五阶主方程
pages.descriptionZh: 把五卷二十章收敛成一套算子代数：元符号字典、形式化映射与五个耦合方程构成的闭环。

pages.title: Exegesis, Book I: The Way, the Vessel and the Operators
pages.description: Chapter by chapter: the two ontological planes, the differential of polarity, the conjugate operators, and symmetry breaking, written as operator axioms.
pages.descriptionZh: 逐章破译道器分层、阴阳差分、乾坤共轭与太极破缺：把本体论写成算子公理。

pages.title: Exegesis, Book II: Transition and the Unfathomable
pages.description: Chapter by chapter: opening and closing, resonance, exhaustion and continuity, and computational irreducibility.
pages.descriptionZh: 逐章破译阖辟之变、相摩相荡、穷变通久与计算不可约简：把动力学写成涌现论。

pages.title: Exegesis, Book III: The Simulacrum and Isomorphism
pages.description: Chapter by chapter: images, configurations, dicta, and the isomorphism theorem of world models.
pages.descriptionZh: 逐章破译立象、设卦、系辞与同构完备性：把世界模型写成张量表征。

pages.title: Exegesis, Book IV: Compression and Singularity
pages.description: Chapter by chapter: minimum description length, zero-bias inference, memory and simulation, and bifurcation detection.
pages.descriptionZh: 逐章破译最小描述长度、零偏推理、藏往知来与分岔奇点侦测。

pages.title: Exegesis, Book V: Timing and Errancy
pages.description: Chapter by chapter: felicity and calamity, foundation and adaptation, acting at the incipient, and negentropic alignment.
pages.descriptionZh: 逐章破译吉凶悔吝、立本趣时、见几而作与负熵对齐：把认知闭环到控制论。
